_comment: Blocks the Building Gadgets must never pick, copy or place. GadgetUtils.isValidBlockState tests this tag and GadgetBuilding, GadgetExchanger and the Copy mode all call it, so an entry here is refused at pick time and skipped inside a copied region; every block listed stays placeable by hand. GadgetCutPaste checks neither this tag nor isValidBlockState and carries block entity NBT through TagPos, so Cut and Paste keeps working on everything listed here and stays the correct tool for moving these blocks. elevatorid:elevators (ticket #252) leaves the gadget preview render broken until another block is picked, because BG2 draws through FakeRenderingWorld whose getBlockEntity fabricates a blank block entity while the elevator model needs the real one for its camouflage. refinedstorage:disk_drive keeps its disks in a block entity the gadgets do not carry, so copying or cutting one loses the storage. The 36 Sophisticated Storage barrels and chests (ticket #255) hold their wood type in the block entity, not in the blockstate: WoodStorageBlockEntity stores it as an Optional<WoodType> and the blockstate carries only facing, flat_top and vertical_facing. GadgetCopyPaste records blockstates only, so pasting a copied barrel builds a fresh block entity with no wood type and the mod falls back to WoodType.ACACIA, which is why a copied dark oak limited barrel came back as an acacia one the player never owned. Shulker boxes are left out on purpose: ShulkerBoxBlockEntity extends StorageBlockEntity directly and has no wood type, so they are not affected by this.
